name: humid_air_1691_coordinator_ceiling_latch_holds_then_releases
description: Real coordinator: a ceiling block holds through the 1F hysteresis band (64.5F) and releases below 64F, when the fan session starts on the still-open window
notes: The coordinator's 5-minute dew-point tick (_sample_humidity_facts -> step_humid_latches) keeps the latch; each decision re-steps it from the facts with the 15-minute median dew point.

Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md Sec 10): (a) effectiveness: without the latch (hysteresis) 21:00 reads natural_ventilation (64.5F < 65F); without the guard 20:10 reads natural_ventilation. (b) docs-production: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Humid-air guard (Issue #1691)' states this rule and production applies it through humidity_facts.humid_air_verdict. (c) occupant: the fan would chatter on and off as the dew point hovers at the ceiling; with the latch it starts once the air has clearly dried.

verdict.summary: Ceiling latch holds at 64.5F, releases at 63.5F

assertions.reason: Outdoor dew point 67F at or above the 65F ceiling: no fan start, the window pauses HVAC.
64.5F is inside the 1F band below the ceiling: the latch holds.
63.5F is below the 64F release: the paused window gets its fan session.
